title: abelmoschus ficulneus
intro: Abelmoschus ficulneus, commonly known as Okra or Abelmosk, is a flowering plant in the mallow family, Malvaceae. This plant is known for its edible seeds, leaves, and flowers, which are rich in vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants. The health benefits of Abelmoschus ficulneus include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and provide anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in the treatment of digestive issues, skin conditions, and respiratory problems, with its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
